description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer for the System.Net.IPEndPoint class within the Orleans.Serialization framework, including read and write methods for serializing and deserializing IPEndPoint objects, as well as associated helper methods and references to other serialization components.

classes.name: IPEndPointCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for the IPEndPoint type, providing methods to read and write IPEndPoint objects to a wire format.

classes.name: EndPointCopier
classes.description: Internal class for shallow copying of EndPoint objects, implementing the ShallowCopier base and IDerivedTypeCopier interface.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Static method to read an IPEndPoint object from the binary reader, handling reference tracking and field extraction.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Instance method to serialize an IPEndPoint object to the binary writer, including writing address and port fields.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Static method to serialize an IPEndPoint object with known type, optimized for predetermined type context.
